set.pl: Orchard farm on a side hill 4 mi E of Dimondale: the Potter 40 of the 1895 Ingham County atlas (Delhi Twp), NE¼ NE¼ sec. 30 T3N R2W, house on the east line
set.t: A box of nuggets was found here in 1895; the legend says more of Carr's gold and money lies nearby. Work the side-hill orchard ground around the old house site. Private land: ask permission first.
pinev: NE¼ NE¼ sec. 30 T3N R2W centroid (BLM PLSS) from the 1895 Ingham County atlas, Delhi plate (about 150 m)
Two sources: a wire story and the local Lansing State Journal, 20 Aug 1895

src: Atlas of Ingham County (1895), Delhi Township plate

tw-mi-agards-landing-gold.st: A 1936 St. Joseph paper puts Jean Agard's 1832 trading post "a mile north of the site of the present town" and says augur digging that year reportedly struck a box.
src: Herald-Press (St. Joseph), 4 Mar 1936, p. 5, "Answer to Century-Old Riddle Again Sought at Paw Paw"
